output.content: I checked the nightly deployment logs for the feature branch this morning. The build step completes successfully, but the pipeline halts immediately after the unit tests finish. The error trace points to a missing configuration variable for consent validation. The job does not proceed to the staging environment. The last successful run was three days ago. Since then, every scheduled deployment has failed at the same checkpoint. The infrastructure remains stable, and the production service is unaffected. The queue of pending changes has grown to twelve items, waiting for the next manual intervention. I observed the same failure pattern in the last four attempts. No other parts of the workflow show errors. The system is idle, waiting for the flag to be defined in the configuration file.
